segments.sn35.112:1.1: “Rūpe, bhikkhave, anabhijānaṃ aparijānaṃ avirājayaṃ appajahaṃ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya.
segments.sn35.112:1.2: Sadde … gandhe … rase … phoṭṭhabbe … dhamme anabhijānaṃ aparijānaṃ avirājayaṃ appajahaṃ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya.
segments.sn35.112:1.7: Rūpe ca kho, bhikkhave, abhijānaṃ parijānaṃ virājayaṃ pajahaṃ bhabbo dukkhakkhayāya.
segments.sn35.112:1.8: Sadde … gandhe … rase … phoṭṭhabbe … dhamme abhijānaṃ parijānaṃ virājayaṃ pajahaṃ bhabbo dukkhakkhayāyā”ti.

lines: 105-113. Dutiye vedanāsukhadukkhaṃ kathitaṃ, taṃ pana vipākasukhadukkhaṃ vaṭṭati.
Pañcamādīsu yaṃ vattabbaṃ siyā, taṃ khandhiyavagge vuttanayameva.
“Ajjhattaṃ sukhaṃ dukkhan”ti vuttattā vimuttisukhassa ca saḷāyatanadukkhassa ca kathitattā vivaṭṭasukhaṃ cettha kathitamevāti sakkā viññātuṃ.
Kāmaṃ khandhiyavagge khandhavasena desanā āgatā, na āyatanavasena.
Ettha pana vattabbaṃ atthajātaṃ khandhiyavagge vuttanayamevāti.
